change: Separated the sale, the strike-off and the taxing unit's resale; recorded that struck-off property is not automatically for sale at a fixed price
prior_statement: Texas tax foreclosure sales and resales of struck-off property are conducted county by county (in Galveston by the Sheriff). The statewide statutory model (Tex. Tax Code chapter 34) has not been read and recorded here.
